Challenge|url=https://pubs.acs.org/cen/government/84/8436gov1.html|website=[[Chemical & Engineering News]]|accessdate=7 November 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Daley|first1=John|title=Denver FAN executive director Stuart Cooper has stated, "Mercola is among thousands of donors and his money accounts for a single-digit percentage of FAN's contributions".<ref>{{Cite news |last=Silberstein |first=Rachel |date=2023-11-27 |title=Fluoridation efforts in Albany face little resistance thus far |url=https://www.timesunion.com/health/article/albany-s-fluoridation-debate-quiet-now-18491344.php |access-date=2023-12-15 |website=[[Times Union (Albany)]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=The Disinformation Dozen |url=https://counterhate.com/research/the-disinformation-dozen/ |access-date=2022-08-24 |website=Center for Countering Digital Hate {{!}} CCDH |language=en-GB}}</ref>

Connett has been invited by environmental organizations opposing fluoridation to lecture on the subject in fluoridating countries such as [[Canada]], [[Israel]], [[Australia]] and [[New Zealand]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Whiteman|first1=Ken|title=Stop fluoridation, London audience told|url=http://digitaljournal.com/article/304245|accessdate=7 May 2017|publisher=Digital Journal|date=3 March 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=תחקיר: מה עושה פלואוריד מסוכן במים שלנו?|url=http://ynet.co.il/Articles/3445244|accessdate=7 November 2016|publisher=[[Ynet]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Field|first1=Tony|title=Anti-fluoride campaigner opens debate in Auckland|url=http://www.newshub.co.nz/nznews/antifluoride-campaigner-opens-debate-in-auckland-2014020216|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160424035703/http://www.newshub.co.nz/nznews/antifluoride-campaigner-opens-debate-in-auckland-2014020216|url-status=dead|archive-date=April 24, 2016|accessdate=7 November 2016|work=[[Newshub]]|date=2 February 2014}}</ref><ref name="Hansen">{{cite news|last1=Hansen|first1=Jane|title=Scare tactics: How anti-fluoride activists push their fear mongering on local councils|url=http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/nsw/scare-tactics-how-antifluoride-activists-push-their-fear-mongering-on-local-councils/news-story/4901f6ce3246a8448d897102c2010c64|accessdate=7 May 2017|publisher=[[The Sunday Telegraph (Sydney)]]|date=6 September 2015}}</ref> Connett has stated, "It’s politics that is interfering with science in this issue...It’s a matter of political will, and you cannot change political will if you don’t get the people. We must involve the people."<ref>{{cite news|last1=Mercola|first1=Dr Joseph|title=The Health Hazards of Water Fluoridation (VIDEO)|url=http://www.huffingtonpost.com/dr-mercola/warning-this-daily-habit-_b_741635.html|accessdate=7 May 2017|work=[[Huffington Post]]|date=11 October 2010}}</ref>

== Early life ==
Connett is English,<ref name=moses>{{cite book |title=Postcolonial Conflict and the Question of Genocide: The Nigeria-Biafra War, 1967–1970 |first1=A. Dirk |last1=Moses |first2=Lasse |last2=Heerten |publisher=Taylor & Francis |date=6 July 2017}}</ref> and is a graduate of [[Cambridge University]]. He holds a Ph.D. in chemistry from [[Dartmouth College]]. 

== Political activism ==
Connett became involved in political activism in 1968. He volunteered for [[Eugene McCarthy]]'s presidential campaign, where he met [[Allard K. Lowenstein]]. Lowenstein and Connett founded the American Committee to Keep Biafra Alive, in response to the famine caused by the [[Nigerian Civil War|Biafran War]]. In 1971, Connett co-founded [[Operation Omega]], a non-violent group taking [[humanitarian aid]] into [[East Pakistan]] during the [[Bangladesh Liberation War]].<ref name=moses/> Paul's wife Ellen was arrested during one of Omega's trips into East Pakistan and spent two months imprisoned there.<ref>{{cite news |work=The Daily Star |title=Accidental Activists |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news/accidental-activists |last=Kar |first=Amitava |date=1 November 2013}}</ref>

== University career ==
After teaching chemistry and toxicology for 23 years at [[St. Lawrence University]], [[Canton, NY]], he retired from his full professorship. He is currently also the director of the ''American Environmental Health Studies Project'' (AEHSP).<ref>[http://www.americanhealthstudies.org/connett.bio.html Paul Connett bio] www.americanhealthstudies.org</ref><ref>[http://www.chelseagreen.com/authors/paul_connett/ Paul Connett and AESHP] www.chelseagreen.com</ref>

== Fluoridation campaign ==
In 2004, Connett published the paper ''50 Reasons to Oppose Fluoridation'' in ''Medical Veritas'',<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Connett|first1=Paul H. |title=Fifty reasons to oppose fluoridation |journal=Medical Veritas: The Journal of Medical Truth |date=April 2004 |volume=1 |issue=1 |pages=70–80 |doi=10.1588/medver.2004.01.00014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Fluoridation questions and answers |url=http://www.health.govt.nz/our-work/preventative-health-wellness/fluoridation/fluoridation-questions-and-answers |website=[[Ministry of Health (New Zealand)]] |access-date=7 November 2016 |archive-date=26 January 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170126174912/http://www.health.govt.nz/our-work/preventative-health-wellness/fluoridation/fluoridation-questions-and-answers |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Fight over fluoride reignited |url=http://www.stuff.co.nz/national/health/9650579/Fight-over-fluoride-reignited |access-date=7 November 2016 |work=[[Stuff.co.nz]] |date=26 January 2014 |language=English}}</ref> a pseudoscientific journal described by [[QuackWatch]] as "fundamentally flawed".<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://quackwatch.org/consumer-education/nonrecperiodicals/ |title=Nonrecommended Periodicals |website=Quackwatch |date=15 November 2019}}</ref> In 2010 he coauthored; ''The Case against Fluoride: How Hazardous Waste Ended Up in Our Drinking Water and the Bad Science and Powerful Politics That Keep It There'' along with Dr. James Beck and Dr. H. Spedding Micklem.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Peckham|first1=Stephen |title=The case against fluoride: how hazardous waste ended up in our drinking water and the bad science and powerful politics that keep it there, by Paul Connett, James Beck, and H Spedding Micklem |journal=[[Critical Public Health]] |date=March 2012 |volume=22 |issue=1 |pages=113–114 |doi=10.1080/09581596.2011.593350 |s2cid=144744675}}</ref>
He also wrote the book in 2013; "The Zero Waste Solution".<ref>[http://zwia.org/aboutus/zwia-history/ Paul Connett and ZWIA], zwia.org{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> and assisted the city of [[Naples]] in pursuing its zero waste strategy.<ref>[http://www.zerowasteeurope.eu/tag/paul-connett/ Paul Connett helping Naples] www.zerowasteeurope.eu</ref>
